title: Ink-smudged footprints
notes: The Bookshop Burglar (bible 6.1 quest 1, mw-e39.10): the trail Snig leaves from the Stacks after the stakeout. Placed as a readable by the Stacks door on Market Green; reading it publishes the note-ink-prints-stacks event.

pages.text:
Small prints, three-toed, in blue-black ink: from the ink pot behind the till, up the shelf ladder, out under the transom and down the back step.

One of them is a thumb. It is pressed hard into the margin of a woodcut, a snake, as if to make sure the snake was real.

The trail turns toward Market Green.
